name: Humblytics
line: Tracks website visits, funnels, experiments, and revenue attribution.

free.text: 25,000 data points on 1 site; no card

cells.cookieless: Yes, no cookies or local-storage IDs
cells.location: EU; some processors in the USA

pv.math: 10,000 pageviews fit within the first 25,000 data points. This one-time starter credit does not refill.
One $39 prepaid pack gives 100,000 points for 12 months. It is a one-time purchase, not a monthly charge.
$39 for the first 100,000 points, plus nine top-ups of 100,000 points at $29 each, to reach 1,000,000 points. That totals $300. Assumes the nine top-ups can be added and used this month.
